# french fixture source

`fr.jsonl` contains two complete, byte-preserved records (`Pr` and `follow`) selected from [kaikki's french extract of english wiktionary](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/French/kaikki.org-dictionary-French.jsonl). selection is the only modification; the records retain sense ids, examples, synonyms, antonyms and upstream metadata. fixture size is 3,627 bytes.

source checked on 2026-10-12 (asia/manila). [source page](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/French/) reports extraction on 2026-10-03 from the english wiktionary dump dated 2026-09-02. full uncompressed utf-8 jsonl download is 583,677,104 bytes; http last-modified is 2026-10-03 10:49:47 utc.

text copyright belongs to wiktionary contributors. this excerpt uses the [creative commons attribution-sharealike 4.0 international](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) option offered by [wiktionary's copyright statement](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Copyrights), which also offers gfdl 1.1 or later. attribution and contributor histories: [Pr](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Pr#French), [Pr history](https://en.wiktionary.org/w/index.php?title=Pr&action=history), [follow](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/follow#French), [follow history](https://en.wiktionary.org/w/index.php?title=follow&action=history). extraction and distribution: tatu ylonen's [wiktextract](https://github.com/tatuylonen/wiktextract) and [kaikki.org](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/French/). wiktextract's mit software license does not replace the dictionary text license. audio urls are retained as metadata; no audio assets are included.

kaikki marks this language-specific postprocessed endpoint [deprecated, pending removal](https://github.com/tatuylonen/wiktextract/issues/1178). the maintained [raw english-edition extract](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/rawdata.html) contains all languages and requires filtering `lang_code == "fr"`. the separate `downloads/fr/fr-extract.jsonl` is the french edition of wiktionary, not this english-edition french subset.
